sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied leon-q-mercado-high-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. Hand re-traced on 2026-10-08 from the owner image at enlarged scale: every distinguishable crown, canopy belt, lawn, planted bed, garden plot, hedge, path, apron, court and parking area is traced where the image shows it, and bare ground stays bare. Re-registered by hand (similarity fit). The central yard is exposed orange soil and stays bare. A row of round crowns lines the front of the diagonal north classroom row; a second row of crowns runs along the south edge of the yard; canopy sits between the west classroom blocks, with single crowns at the west edge, and forest fills the east end. The pale dirt walk from the south-east gate (extended to the mapped road, which runs south of the image's road) curves up into the yard toward the north row. Registration: hand similarity fit to hand-picked OSM roof corners and junctions; independent check errors 1.63 m, 5.17 m. Trunks sit inside their observed crowns; crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
